comments: Decision given in chat on 2026-09-04 and transcribed here by the orchestrator; the artifact, not the message, is the approval. All 8 acceptance criteria approved for the full re-run of ETA-351. The criteria are byte-identical to the set approved on 2026-08-31 under APR-AC-ETA-351-001 v1, reproduced independently from a freshly fetched Jira snapshot. The six ambiguities AMB-ETA-351-001 through AMB-ETA-351-006 were NOT answered by this decision and remain REVIEW_REQUIRED; they are deferred, not resolved, exactly as in the previous run. Any criterion depending on one of them is approved as written, meaning the observable behaviour is agreed while the underlying rule stays unstated.

itemDecisions.comment: Page offers a way to declare the sign-in kind before details are entered.
Both sign-in kinds are offered and are distinguishable.
Choosing organization sign-in changes which details are asked for. AMB-ETA-351-001 remains unanswered.
Password is not readable on screen. AMB-ETA-351-004 remains unanswered.
Correct details reach the Home page. AMB-ETA-351-006 remains unanswered.
Wrong details are refused and reported. AMB-ETA-351-003 remains unanswered.
Missing details are refused and reported. AMB-ETA-351-003 and AMB-ETA-351-005 remain unanswered.
The two failure responses are distinguishable. AMB-ETA-351-003 remains unanswered.
